workflows.purpose: Guide a teacher from subject/grade through curriculum-aligned lesson design to a reviewed, publishable lesson.
entryConditions: Teacher may create resources in the target project
No conflicting open create-lesson session for the same lessonId (optional)

phases.title: Start
phases.description: Open a new lesson workflow session.

phases.title: Select Subject
phases.description: Teacher declares subject for the lesson.

phases.title: Select Grade
phases.description: Teacher declares grade band.

phases.title: Load Curriculum
phases.description: System loads curriculum pack for subject and grade.

phases.title: Define Competencies
phases.description: Teacher confirms competencies (AI may propose).

phases.title: Define Objectives
phases.description: Teacher confirms learning objectives.

phases.title: Choose Teaching Strategy
phases.description: Teacher selects instructional strategy.

phases.title: Generate Lesson
phases.description: AI Orchestrator generates a draft lesson under teacher authority.

phases.title: Validate
phases.description: Structural and pedagogical validation of the draft.

phases.title: Teacher Review
phases.description: Teacher reviews, edits, or requests regeneration.

phases.title: Save Draft
phases.description: Persist draft without publishing (Editing + SaveDraft).

phases.title: Ready
phases.description: Teacher confirms the lesson is ready.

phases.title: Publish
phases.description: Publish the approved lesson resource.

validationRules.description: Subject and grade must be set before PlanningCompleted
Competencies and objectives required before Generate
Teacher ValidationPassed required before Ready
No learner labeling or diagnostic language in outputs

recovery.notes: Failed → Retry returns to Planning; ValidationFailed → Editing; Cancelled → Restore from history or start a new session. AI never dispatches.

completionCriteria: Teacher confirmed review (ValidationPassed → Ready or Publish path)
